name: Rage of Ages
label: Quest
description: Rage of Ages: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ah, friend, welcome back. It seems you enjoyed the effect of the robust, operational imbue, derived from snickerfang. Be warned, while the immediate effect is a titanic burst of strength, the long term effects on your spirit and intelligence could be hazardous.
With that said, do you require more? If so, bring me another three snickerfang jowls, two blasted boar lungs, and one scorpok pincer.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the beast organs?

clips.title: Completion
paras: There you go! Remember, use it sparingly. If you require another, come see me after you finish the one you currently have in your possession.
